40786-the-black-riders-and-other-lines.title: The Black Riders And Other Lines
40786-the-black-riders-and-other-lines.creator: Unknown
40786-the-black-riders-and-other-lines.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Then--at fateful time--a Wrong called,  And God turned, heeding. Lo, the ship, at this opportunity, slipped slyly,  Making cunning noiseless travel down the ways. So that, forever rudderless, it went upon the seas  Going ridiculous voyages,  Making quaint progress,  Turning as with serious purpose  Before stupid winds. And there were many in the sky  Who laughed at this thing.

He could talk and walk and live as you do, children; and still he was only a marionette! How sad the little fellow felt when he saw his father disappear in his little boat over the sea!

arxiv-2109-08457.title: A Maximum Principle for a Time-Optimal Bilevel Sweeping Control Problem
arxiv-2109-08457.creator: Fernando Lobo Pereira, Nathalie T. Khalil
arxiv-2109-08457.description: Abstract In this article, we investigate a time-optimal state-constrained bilevel optimal control problem whose lower-level dynamics feature a sweeping control process involving a truncated normal cone . By bilevel, it is meant that the optimization of the upper level problem is carried out over the solution set of the lower level problem.

arxiv-2112-06060.title: GenMotion: Data-driven Motion Generators for Real-time Animation Synthesis
arxiv-2112-06060.creator: Yizhou Zhao, Wensi Ai, Liang Qiu, Pan Lu, Shi Feng, Tian Han, Song-Chun Zhu
arxiv-2112-06060.description: Abstract With the recent success of deep learning algorithms, many researchers have focused on generative models for human motion animation. However, the research community lacks a platform for training and benchmarking various algorithms, and the animation industry needs a toolkit for implementing advanced motion synthesizing techniques.

arxiv-2210-10970.title: Federated Learning via Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
arxiv-2210-10970.creator: Min Fu, Yuanming Shi, and Yong Zhou
arxiv-2210-10970.description: Abstract To enable communication-efficient federated learning (FL), this paper studies an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-enabled FL system, where the UAV coordinates distributed ground devices for a shared model training. Specifically, by exploiting the UAV’s high altitude and mobility, the UAV can proactively establish short-distance line-of-sight links with devices and prevent any device from being a communication straggler.

arxiv-2303-17501.title: An estimate arising in scattering theory
arxiv-2303-17501.creator: R.M. Brown
arxiv-2303-17501.description: Abstract We prove a decay estimate for an operator that arises in two-dimensional scattering problem. The goal of this note is to prove an estimate from a paper of Klein, Sjöstrand and Stoilov [ KSS23 ] that is used to establish decay estimates for a scattering transform that arises in the study of one of the Davey-Stewartson II equations.

arxiv-2308-15184.title: ltl f Synthesis Under Environment Specifications for Reachability and Safety Properties
arxiv-2308-15184.creator: Benjamin Aminof, Giuseppe De Giacomo, Antonio Di Stasio, Hugo Francon, Sasha Rubin, Shufang Zhu
arxiv-2308-15184.description: Abstract In this paper, we study ltl f synthesis under environment specifications for arbitrary reachability and safety properties. We consider both kinds of properties for both agent tasks and environment specifications, providing a complete landscape of synthesis algorithms. For each case, we devise a specific algorithm (optimal wrt complexity of the problem) and prove its correctness.

arxiv-2406-15260.creator: S. Ravikularaman, S. Recchia, V. H. M. Phan, S. Gabici
arxiv-2406-15260.description: Abstract Context. The H 2 \mathrm{H}_{2} ionisation rate in the central molecular zone, located in the Galactic centre, is estimated to be ζ ∼ 2 × 10 − 14 ​ s − 1 \zeta\sim 2\times 10^{-14}\penalty\ \mathrm{s}^{-1} , based on observations of H + 3 {}_{3}^{+} lines.

arxiv-2407-13494.title: Streaming Technologies and Serialization Protocols: Empirical Performance Analysis
arxiv-2407-13494.creator: Samuel Jackson, Nathan Cummings, Saiful Khan
arxiv-2407-13494.description: Abstract Efficient data streaming is essential for real-time data analytics, visualization, and machine learning model training, particularly when dealing with high-volume datasets. Various streaming technologies and serialization protocols have been developed to cater to different streaming requirements, each performing differently depending on specific tasks and datasets involved.

arxiv-2512-18823.title: Misbehavior Forecasting for Focused Autonomous Driving Systems Testing Conference: IEEE/ACM International Conference on Software Engineering; 12-18 April, 2026; Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
arxiv-2512-18823.creator: M M Abid Naziri, Stefano Carlo Lambertenghi, Andrea Stocco, Marcelo d’Amorim
arxiv-2512-18823.description: Abstract . Simulation-based testing is the standard practice for assessing the reliability of self-driving cars’ software before deployment. Existing bug-finding techniques are either unreliable or expensive. We build on the insight that near misses observed during simulations may point to potential failures.

arxiv-2602-13769.title: OR-Agent: Bridging Evolutionary Search and Structured Research for Automated Algorithm Discovery
arxiv-2602-13769.creator: Qi Liu, Ruochen Hao*, Can Li, Wanjing Ma
arxiv-2602-13769.description: Abstract Automating scientific discovery in complex, experiment-driven domains requires more than iterative mutation of programs; it demands structured hypothesis management, environment interaction, and principled reflection. We present OR-Agent, a configurable multi-agent research framework designed for automated exploration in rich experimental environments.

pmc-10589776.title: Supervised multicomponent exercise as an adjuvant program for people with unilateral and/or bilateral chronic vestibular hypofunction: EXERVEST study protocol
pmc-10589776.creator: Maitane Ruiz-Rios, Asier Lekue, Jon Pinedo-López, Mikel Tous-Espelosin, Iñaki Arratibel-Imaz, Ibai García-Tabar, Sara Maldonado-Martin
pmc-10589776.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundUnilateral and bilateral peripheral vestibular hypofunction (UVH and BVH) often complains of dizziness, gaze, and balance disturbances. There is a lack of evidence on exercise intervention in UVH and BVH patients. To investigate the effect of an eight-week supervised multicomponent exercise program in people suffering from UVH or BVH in comparison with a control group doing conventional vestibular rehabilitation at home.MethodsThis longitudinal, controlled, randomized, prospective, single-blinded, two-arm, parallel intervention study will include 66 adults (≥18 years old) with chronic UVH or BVH.

pmc-11344620.title: Safety and Efficacy of Oral Mifepristone for Cervical Ripening and Induction of Labor
pmc-11344620.creator: Pratap Pharande, Ananya R Kiran, Shivani Patel, Hada V Vanrajsinh
pmc-11344620.description: BackgroundLabor induction, a common practice to prevent maternal and fetal complications from prolonged labor, involves stimulating contractions before they begin naturally. This can be achieved through medications, mechanical methods, or surgical interventions. Cervical ripening is crucial for successful delivery. When the cervix is not sufficiently ripe, drugs are often used to augment this process chemically.

pmc-11381825.title: The ability of SPEEK to promote the proliferation and osteogenic differentiation of BMSCs on PEEK surfaces
pmc-11381825.creator: Shuang Wang, Jun-xiong Ma, Liang Zheng, Hong Wang, Hai-long Yu, Yu Chen
pmc-11381825.description: To investigate the ability of sulfonated polyetheretherketone (SPEEK) to promote the proliferation and osteogenic differentiation of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs) and compare the effects of different degrees of sulfonation (DS), SPEEK was made with two different DS. The L-SPEEK group had a lower DS, while the H-SPEEK group had a higher DS.

pmc-11432493.title: COPD Patient’s Outcomes following Total Knee Arthroplasty—An Analysis of the National Inpatients Sampling (2016–2020)
pmc-11432493.creator: Aviram Albagly, Ofer Kobo, Yaniv Yonai, Yaron Berkovich, Yaniv Steinfeld, Filippo Migliorini
pmc-11432493.description: Introduction: Total knee arthroplasty (TKA) is a common elective procedure aimed at improving patients’ quality of life. Patients undergoing this procedure can have a wide variety of comorbidities, including chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Several studies demonstrated a higher risk of postoperative complications for this patient population.

pmc-13194386.title: 3D Printing in custom tray design for complete dentures in patients with flabby tissues
pmc-13194386.creator: Edgar Garcia Zea, Pablo Lenin Benitez Sellan
pmc-13194386.description: BackgroundFlabby ridge tissues present a significant challenge in complete denture fabrication because their mobility compromises support, stability, and retention. Conventional techniques such as the open window, selective pressure, or mucostatic methods attempt to control tissue displacement but often rely heavily on operator skill and may result in unpredictable outcomes.

pmc-13235409.title: Role of Dlk1–Notch signaling in impaired neurogenesis and cognitive decline in chronic cerebral hypoperfusion
pmc-13235409.creator: Yoshiyuki Moriyama, Rena Hasegawa, Hikaru Endo, Sayaka Matsumura, Ryotaro Kaneko, Hideki Hayashi, Yui Iwatani, Norio Takagi
pmc-13235409.description: Vascular dementia (VaD) is characterized by chronic cerebral hypoperfusion, leading to cognitive decline. Impaired hippocampal neurogenesis is a crucial pathological feature of VaD. Delta-like 1 homolog (Dlk1)-Notch signaling may contribute to neural stem cell regulation, but the involvement of Dlk1-Notch signaling in impaired hippocampal neurogenesis during hypoperfusion is unclear.

pmc-13395776.title: Clinical characteristics and cytokine profiles for early prediction of severe Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia in children: a prospective cohort study
pmc-13395776.creator: Jiayi Xue, Tao Ai, Yinghong Fan, Cheng Xie, Wanmin Xia, Li Wang
pmc-13395776.description: IntroductionTo investigate the clinical characteristics and cytokine profiles of children with Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia (MPP) and to establish a predictive nomogram for the early recognition of severe Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia (SMPP).MethodsThis prospective study enrolled 445 children with MPP admitted to the Department of Pediatric Respiratory Medicine of Chengdu Women's and Children's Central Hospital between December 2022 and December 2023.

pmc-13671364.title: A suzetrigine-based multimodal analgesic protocol in spine surgery: a single-center retrospective cohort study of opioid consumption, pain, and length of stay
pmc-13671364.creator: Teja Yeramosu, Gabriella A Perez, Huniya Masood, Janeliz Mercado, Allison L Williams, Andrew P Alvarez, Oscar Santalo, Daniel R Fassett
pmc-13671364.description: Highlights•Patients receiving suzetrigine had lower directly observed 48-hour opioid consumption after spine surgery.•The lower 48-hour opioid consumption was supported by an all-patient sensitivity analysis.•After multivariable adjustment, suzetrigine was not independently associated with 48-hour opioid consumption.•Day-of-surgery and discharge opioid consumption were also lower with suzetrigine, while pain scores and length of stay were similar between groups.
